chunks: 12 - Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Zakariyya ibn Salih ibn Zufar, al-Adawi, Abu Sa'id, al-Basri.

key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ جِدًّا: Very weak (in terms of hadith narrator reliability)

ai.seo_question: What is the status of Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Zakariyya in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book 'Kitab al-Duafa' describing the narrator Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Zakariyya. He is characterized as 'very weak' (da'if jiddan) in his hadith transmission and is also described as 'a liar' (kaddab).
